positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
· Synchronized the internal compensation planning application to provide all users with an up-to-date view of employee compensation data by:
     - Creating client-side polling mechanism to detect employee state modifications
     - Designing and implementing strategy for propagating compensation data changes to user interface
     - Adding functionality to retrieve and process compensation data updates from the database
     - Designed tool to enable users to compare and merge concurrent modifications

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Software Development Intern in Mortgages Valuation 
· Designed and implemented for the Mortgages Valuation System (MVS):
     - End-to-end alert system that stores, delivers, configures and monitors alerts generated by MVS
     - Database and corresponding database accessors for storing alert information
     - Alert system user interface that supports quick identification of critical areas of MVS, configuration of alert properties and recipients, and a filterable alert history
· Integrated new alert system with existing alert-generating components of MVS to ensure backward compatibility

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed functionality used to disable and reinstate all fraudulent customer accounts
• Automated the execution of all actions related to disabling and reinstating a customer account, including order and
shipment cancellation, account status modification, updating customer information in databases and event logging
• Implemented re-driving mechanism that ensured successful execution of the disable and reinstate account functionalities
• Performed both unit and integrated testing on the disable, reinstate and re-driving functionalities

positions.title: Software Designer
positions.description:
• Implemented a class structure to store event data on Motorola phone component of Intelligent Calendar Assistant.
• Created function for inputting and organizing data sent to Intelligent Calendar Assistant phone component.
• Designed function for converting user event input into event-based information categories on desktop component of
Intelligent Calendar Assistant
• Assisted in testing and debugging desktop and phone components of Intelligent Calendar Assistant.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Developed and released documentation of overnight securities’ calculations of Fixed-Income Trading Software.
• Collaborated with Quality Assurance to test and debug new releases of Fixed-Income Trading Software.
• Updated different versions of Fixed-Income Trading Software to include parallel functionalities.
